fact: CIVIPOL's project page says its EU-funded modernisation project (from January 2021, status ongoing) secures birth registration processing by creating a database.
system: Projet d'appui a la modernisation de l'etat civil en RCA

fact: Oubangui Médias reports the civil-status directorate (DGDEC), with CIVIPOL, trained agents on 16-17 July 2026 in digitising civil registers, and trained agents have started digitising them into the Registre National de l'État Civil.
Central African Republic's delegate said a digitalisation process backed by the European Union is at pilot phase and should extend to 40 localities in 2025.

The DGDEC director general told the July 2026 EGMRG meeting that the national civil-registry database (RNEC) holds more than 225,000 birth records, that digitisation of civil-registry documents is under way, that a 45-centre operational map is validated and that an integrated Central African civil-registry software is in development, with EU/CIVIPOL MODERO support.

CIVIPOL, under an EU project supporting the MATDDL, recruits an archiving expert to validate the dematerialisation scheme for civil registry records and to support the digitisation team in setting up the solution and site for indexing civil registry documents in the Central African Republic.
system: solution and site for indexing civil registry documents
